message: メリロットさんの手
Unrelated to KiraFes or the Holy Night Festival. Neither a letter to the Student Council nor a request for "Angelic Agent"--just a small matter of concern.
During biology class, a single hamster escaped from its cage in the science room. At Ryuusei Academy, surrounded by lush greenery, searching for it would prove extremely difficult.
I would only search for this one day. Having decided that, I check the buildings one by one. Since it's cold out, it's sure to be hiding indoors.

name: Melilot
message: 「It's dead, isn't it.」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, if it's alive, it's bound to die eventually.」
The place on campus most likely to have food after Prier. First and foremost, I visited the Kujou family mansion.

name: Synn
message: 「Ah!? W-Was I too late...」
Melilot holds the hamster cupped in both palms, as if trying to warm it.

name: Helena
message: 「Hii, Synn-chan\s04」
In stark contrast to Helena's cheerful greeting, the sleek-furred creature resting in Melilot's hands doesn't twitch a muscle.

name: Synn
message: 「That's the hamster that got out of the science room... Did it freeze? It did get pretty chilly today.」

name: Melilot
message: 「There are no external injuries. It was likely either hypothermia or a heart attack.」

name: Helena
message: 「Getting to leap out of its cage and see the outside world... Maybe little Hammy was just overwhelmed with emotion?」

name: Melilot
message: 「You're being far too sentimental, Helena? Every living thing should be permitted to die.」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, that's a sound argument.」

name: Melilot
message: 「...What if I were able to live forever?」

name: Helena
message: 「If you're going to claim eternity, Melilot, you'd have to know what the end of time is like.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I do not know.」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, geez, then you're no different from me, Melilot.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Hehe, so it would seem.」
I want to take the hamster back and bury it. However, I have no idea what words to use to chime in on their conversation.

name: Melilot
message: 「...Sakura-kun, how old were you when you first became aware of death?」
Melilot speaks to me while keeping the hamster cradled in both hands.

name: Synn
message: 「Around three or four years old, I think. I got scared at night and couldn't fall asleep.」

name: Synn
message: 「I can sleep normally now, though...」

name: Helena
message: 「I'm about the same. I actually ran an experiment to see what happens when things die.」
I-I'd expect nothing less from Helena-san. Something like that never even crossed my mind.

name: Melilot
message: 「How fascinating. What sort of results did you get?」

name: Helena
message: 「First, I gathered dead little birds, fish, and bugs, along with some rotten fruit, and secretly lined them all up under my bed.」
H-has this person had a bird's-eye perspective on life ever since she was a kid?

name: Helena
message: 「In the end, their states just changed--not a single thing actually vanished. That was my conclusion.」

name: Melilot
message: 「That is a meaningful experiment.」

name: Helena
message: 「Also, the state of my head changed too. My parents found out about my experiment, and Mother smacked me across the head with all her might.」

name: Melilot
message: 「That is an even more meaningful outcome.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha... whaaat!?」
Inside Melilot-san's hands, the hamster suddenly begins to move.

name: Melilot
message: 「N-no, that's absurd...!」

name: Helena
message: 「Ta-da! It came back to life! Way to go, Melilot~, woo-hoo♪」

name: Melilot
message: 「Impossible!!」

name: Synn
message: 「B-but it really did come back to life, didn't it! Things like that happen sometimes, you know.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I despise miracles and coincidences!」

name: Helena
message: 「Ho-ho-ho, it was inevitable, my dear Melilot.」

name: Helena
message: 「Did you know? Hamsters go into hibernation when they're somewhere cold. When that happens, if you share your body warmth with them, they wake right up.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, so that means it was alive from the very beginning.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Th-thank goodness...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Wait, aaaah!? That's why you ordered me to warm up the hamster! Couldn't you have just done it yourself!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Because~ Melilot's little hands are way warmer and cozieri♪」

name: Melilot
message: 「Is that really the reason...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Still, they say people with cold hands have warm hearts, so I--」

name: Helena
message: 「That's not how it goes, Melilot. People with warm hands have even warmer hearts」

name: Melilot
message: 「Helena...」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, to tell you the truth, it was just too much trouble to go return it to the biology lab」

name: Melilot
message: 「Huh」

name: Helena
message: 「So anyway, I'm counting on you!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Ah, w-wait a second, Helena--!」
In the end, Melilot-san is completely wrapped around Helena-san's little finger.
